div.div:
PLIC (PlicBaseAddr=0x0C000000, PlicSize=0x400000 = 4 MiB; standard RISC-V PLIC layout)
soc_plic, M-mode single context; sources: 1=UART, 2=iDMA transfer completion. Reachable via axi_xbar port[5] -> soc_axi_to_reg; see sw/c/common/plic.h.

div.div:
iDMA config (DmaBaseAddr=0x01000000, DmaSize=0x1000 = 4 KiB)
idma_reg32_3d registers behind the accel socket (axi_xbar port[4] -> soc_axi_to_apb); CoreJack irq W1C at +0xF00. Program SRC/DST/LENGTH, read NEXT_ID_0 to launch; see sw/c/common/dma.h.

div.div:
CLINT (ClintBaseAddr=0x02000000, ClintSize=0x10000 = 64 KiB)
Machine timer (mtime/mtimecmp) and IPI; reachable via axi_xbar port[3] -> soc_axi_to_reg -> clint. RTC ticks from a divided SoC clock (12.5 MHz at the 25 MHz baseline).

div.div:
RAM (RamBaseAddr=0x80000000, RamWords=262144 -> 1 MiB)
Boot vector is core-dependent: CV32E40S boots at RamBaseAddr; Ibex, CV32E40P/X, CVA6, SERV, PicoRV32 and CVW boot at RamBaseAddr+0x80 (Ibex's IF stage forces {boot_addr[31:8], 8'h80}; the CVW adapter overrides the upstream RESET_VECTOR).
Banked 8x 64-bit (full interleaving by 64-bit word index).

div.div:
UART (UartBaseAddr=0x10000000, 4 KiB region)
APB; 115200 baud at 25 MHz core clock; reachable via axi_xbar port[1] -> soc_axi_to_apb -> apb_uart_wrap.

div.div:
DEBUG (DebugBaseAddr default 0x00000000, DebugSize=0x1000)
DM register window served by soc_axi_to_dm; halt=DebugBaseAddr+0x800, exception=+0x810.

div.div:
Notes:
- soc_top builds the AXI fabric address map from its module parameters (RamBaseAddr / UartBaseAddr / DebugBaseAddr / ClintBaseAddr).
- The smoke stub branch (EnablePlatform=0) uses local UART0_/DEBUG0_ constants matching tb/test_smoke.py.
